title: Shanghai Marathon unites global runners
claims: The 2025 Shanghai Marathon was held on 30 November with 23,000 runners starting from the Bund Bull at 07:00.
The 2026 Shanghai Marathon will be held on 6 December, with registration opening no later than the end of April.
From 2026, a 5 km fitness run will be held on 5 December and will share the same finish line.
The 2025 men's winner was Milkesa Mengesha in 2:06:25 and the women's winner was Brigid Kosgei in 2:16:36.
Domestic winners were Feng Peiyou in 2:08:36 and Zhang Deshun in 2:25:13.
There were 43 medical stations along the route, a comprehensive medical centre near the finish and four additional post-race medical points.
Nearly 4,400 volunteers served across more than 60 positions.
Runners came from 26 countries and regions.
